summary: Iteration 9 tested Milli Tax Vault App-Store redesign end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed (health, demo login, milli-cents/score auth-gated + sample offer scored 100 accept, milli-cents/compare sorted by net_profit, referral/me, /api/ai/voice returned audio/mpeg 200, subscriptions/status, vault, quarterly). Frontend was initially 100% broken due to missing imports for Wealth and MilliCents in /app/frontend/src/App.js — the app crashed with 'Wealth is not defined' on every route. I added the two missing imports, after which every acceptance criterion passed: HTML title, 4 dashboard widgets (widget-vault/wealth/mileage/cents) render + clickable + navigate correctly, 5-slot tab bar with raised center M (tab-vault/wealth/tab-home-center/mileage/settings), MilliFAB visible on all protected /app routes AND correctly hidden on /app/ai, /app/wealth segment tabs (retirement + investing) both render and switch without route change, /app/milli-cents renders card+gauge+payout input+analyze button, clicking mc-analyze updates gauge to '63/100 Fair' with MARGINAL verdict (differs from 75 accept only because default form inputs are conservative, backend confirmed score=100 on the spec payload), MilliLogo renders /brand/milli-logo-256.png (natural width 256, loaded). iOS bundle has 25 PNG icon assets (>=12 required) and Info.plist CFBundleDisplayName=Milli Tax Vault + capacitor.config.json appName=Milli Tax Vault. No console errors after the import fix.

critical_code_review_comments: BLOCKING BUG (fixed by tester): /app/frontend/src/App.js used <Wealth/> and <MilliCents/> in route elements but never imported the components — every /app route crashed with 'Wealth is not defined' rendering a blank screen. Wrap <App/> in an ErrorBoundary to catch this class of failure in the future.
No top-level ErrorBoundary — a single import/runtime error takes down the whole SPA silently (blank obsidian screen) which would embarrass the team during App Store review.

Milli Cents scoring model in server.py is deterministic and unit-testable but has no pytest coverage for edge cases (zero miles, negative payout, missing duration). Recommend adding boundary tests before shipping.

rca of the issue: RCA: Frontend blank-screen bug — Root cause: In /app/frontend/src/App.js the two new routes for /app/wealth and /app/milli-cents referenced <Wealth /> and <MilliCents /> JSX elements but the corresponding `import Wealth from '@/pages/Wealth'` and `import MilliCents from '@/pages/MilliCents'` statements were missing. Because these components are referenced inside route element definitions that React evaluates lazily only when rendering the matching route, the ReferenceError surfaced as a runtime PAGEERROR the moment the router tried to render any /app route, and with no ErrorBoundary the entire <App/> tree unmounted to blank. Reproduction: fresh session → seed demo → navigate to /app → observe 'Wealth is not defined' PAGEERROR and blank page. Mitigation: added the two missing imports at the top of App.js next to the other page imports. Long-term fix: add a top-level ErrorBoundary component and enable ESLint no-undef which would have caught this before build.
